items.review_text: My rescue dog Barnaby used to shake uncontrollably at groomers. The team at Blackberry Luxury Grooming took their time, gave him breaks, and now he practically trots right in!
The haircut precision is unmatched! They actually listen to how you want your dog cut. The blueberry facial left Charlie smelling amazing for weeks.
Easy online booking, fair pricing, and clean facilities. The nail trim and dremel smoothing is the best in town. Highly recommend!
